notes.title: Addressing a few issues.
notes.content:
Over the past few days we've received some feedback about Stifled and we'd like to address them here and keep everyone updated!

[b]Controller Support[/b]
You can only have one controller attached at one point.
[list]
    [*]Xbox Game Pad - Supported
    [*]Oculus Touch - Supported
    [*]HTC Vive Steam Controllers - Currently in Review
[/list]

[b]Optimisation Issues[/b]
[list]
    [*]We seem to have issues with Nvidia 700 series cards
    [*]There are complains about VR performance as well.
    [*]We're in the midst of narrowing down these issues and will hopefully have an update soon.
[/list]

Thanks for all the support and feedback! It's has been really helpful and humbling!

notes.title: Translations Announcements!
notes.content:
Hey peeps!

We just wanted to drop a quick note that Stifled will be shipping with few more languages on-top of English thanks to the following partners and friends!

[list]
    [*]Português Brasileiro -[url=https://www.facebook.com/blasterlizardcompany/]BlasterLizard Co.[/url] 
    [*]Simplified Chinese - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/AnJetCat/]AnJetCat[/url]
    [*]Traditional Chinese - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/AnJetCat/]AnJetCat[/url]
[/list]

So, if you'd like to see Stifled in your language please drop justin@gattaigames.com an email*!

*Access to the game and translation files will be subject to our discretion
